lines: At two a.m., just a little
Without a moment to look back
The destination of the farewell that arrived
The footprints left in the sand
The magic that lets me meet you again
I kept only one thing in my heart
The song I learned that day
There are days when I just exist
The path drawn in my dream
Even if it's an uncertain hope
Because that alone lets me move forward
Having left everything up to yesterday behind as it is
The footprints left in the sand as well
The magic that lets me meet you again
I kept only one thing in my heart
Ah, I wonder if I grew a little taller again
